summary.en: Your period is here. Estrogen and progesterone are at their lowest — expect lower energy and a need for rest.
summary.hr: Menstruacija je tu. Estrogen i progesteron su na najnižoj razini - očekuj manje energije i potrebu za odmorom.

recommendations.en: Eat iron-rich foods (leafy greens, legumes, red meat) to replace losses from bleeding.
recommendations.hr: Jedi namirnice bogate željezom (zeleno lisnato povrće, mahunarke, crveno meso) kako bi nadoknadila gubitke uslijed krvarenja.

recommendations.en: Favor gentle movement — walking, stretching, restorative yoga.
recommendations.hr: Preferiraj blagu tjelesnu aktivnost - hodanje, istezanje, restorativnu jogu.

recommendations.en: Prioritize sleep and rest; this is a natural low-energy phase.
recommendations.hr: Daj prioritet snu i odmoru; ovo je prirodna faza niže energije.

recommendations.en: Heat therapy (heating pad, warm bath) can ease cramps.
recommendations.hr: Toplinska terapija (termofor, topla kupka) može ublažiti grčeve.

summary.en: Estrogen is rising. Energy, mood, and cognitive sharpness typically increase through this phase.
summary.hr: Estrogen raste. Energija, raspoloženje i kognitivna oštrina obično rastu tijekom ove faze.

recommendations.en: High-intensity training is well tolerated — this is a good window for harder workouts.
recommendations.hr: Visoko-intenzivni trening se dobro podnosi - ovo je dobar period za zahtjevnije treninge.

recommendations.en: Good time for creative work, brainstorming, and starting new projects.
recommendations.hr: Dobro vrijeme za kreativan rad, brainstorming i pokretanje novih projekata.

recommendations.en: Social energy tends to be higher — plan social activities now.
recommendations.hr: Društvena energija je obično viša - sada je dobro vrijeme za druženja.

recommendations.en: Support rising estrogen with fiber-rich vegetables and fermented foods.
recommendations.hr: Podrži rastući estrogen povrćem bogatim vlaknima i fermentiranom hranom.

summary.en: Estrogen and LH peak around ovulation. This is usually the highest-energy window of the cycle.
summary.hr: Estrogen i LH hormon dosežu vrhunac oko ovulacije. Ovo je obično razdoblje najveće energije u ciklusu.

recommendations.en: Peak energy and strength — a great time for strength training and PRs.
recommendations.hr: Vrhunac energije i snage - odlično vrijeme za trening snage i osobne rekorde.

recommendations.en: Communication and confidence peak — good timing for important meetings or decisions.
recommendations.hr: Komunikacija i samopouzdanje su na vrhuncu - dobro vrijeme za važne sastanke ili odluke.

recommendations.en: Fertility is at its highest in this window if pregnancy is a goal or to avoid.
recommendations.hr: Plodnost je u ovom razdoblju najveća, bilo da je trudnoća cilj ili nešto što se izbjegava.

recommendations.en: Stay well hydrated and support the body with antioxidant-rich foods (berries, colorful vegetables).
recommendations.hr: Ostani dobro hidrirana i podrži tijelo hranom bogatom antioksidansima (bobičasto voće, šareno povrće).

summary.en: Progesterone rises then falls. PMS-type symptoms (mood changes, bloating, fatigue) are common, especially in the late luteal phase.
summary.hr: Progesteron raste pa pada. Simptomi slični PMS-u (promjene raspoloženja, nadutost, umor) su česti, posebno u kasnoj lutealnoj fazi.

recommendations.en: Reduce caffeine intake — it can worsen anxiety and breast tenderness in this phase.
recommendations.hr: Smanji unos kofeina - može pogoršati anksioznost i osjetljivost grudi u ovoj fazi.

recommendations.en: Magnesium and calcium may help ease cramps, mood swings, and bloating.
recommendations.hr: Magnezij i kalcij mogu pomoći u ublažavanju grčeva, promjena raspoloženja i nadutosti.

recommendations.en: Favor moderate exercise (walking, pilates, swimming) over high-intensity training as progesterone drops.
recommendations.hr: Preferiraj umjerenu tjelesnu aktivnost (hodanje, pilates, plivanje) umjesto visoko-intenzivnog treninga dok progesteron pada.

recommendations.en: You may need more sleep — go to bed earlier if you're feeling fatigued.
recommendations.hr: Možda ćeš trebati više sna - lezi ranije ako se osjećaš umorno.
